response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced and technically versatile senior/staff engineer with genuine developer-tooling exposure (custom test runner, assertion library, CI/CD setup) and strong communication skills evidenced by workshops and talks. However, the role is fundamentally a people-management position requiring 2+ years of direct people leadership, performance management, and 1:1s, and there is no evidence anywhere in his 15+ year history of managing engineers, running performance reviews, or holding a formal leadership title — his entire career has been as an individual contributor across a large number of short-to-medium tenures.
strengths: 15+ years of broad, hands-on technical experience spanning web, mobile, embedded, and backend systems
Direct experience building developer productivity tools: custom D test runner (Trial), assertion library (Fluent-Asserts), CI/CD and GitLab infrastructure setup
Strong track record of teaching and knowledge-sharing (workshops, conference talks, Selenium/TDD courses) indicating mentoring capability
concerns: No evidence of formal people-management experience (no direct reports, performance reviews, or 1:1s mentioned anywhere in resume)
Career history shows exclusively individual-contributor titles (Developer/Senior/Staff Engineer), never a lead or manager role
Frequent job changes (many roles under 2 years) raise questions about stability and depth of technical leadership impact at any single organization

key_factors.factor: Relevant developer-tools and testing infrastructure background
No demonstrated technical leadership or org-change leadership role
